name: code-path-traced-film
description: Make a short animated film in which everything is code the agent writes, including the renderer: a path tracer in one WebGL2 shader (no Blender, no three.js, no meshes, no textures), characters and props as signed distance fields, a meadow of analytic curved grass blades, moon, firefly and window lights with soft shadows, depth of field and motion blur, a variance-guided denoiser, a score synthesized in numpy from the same timeline, captions and an encode. Includes the complete tested film "The Smallest Star" (70 s, 11 shots, two characters) as a starter, a live page that runs the same renderer in the browser, and the speed-ups and traps found while making it. Use when someone asks for a film, short or music piece "made entirely in code", "write your own renderer / ray tracer / path tracer and make a film with it", a storybook or clay-diorama 3D short without Blender, a "no assets, no video model" showcase of what a coding model can do, or a remake of The Smallest Star with another story. Not for a Blender film (blender-code-film), a three.js explainer (code-3d-explainer), recording a browser game (code-game-trailer), 2D motion graphics (kinetic-type-art, hyperframes) or AI-generated footage (varg-ai).
